name: Summary card
summary: One term, plan or policy explained: what kind of thing it is, a short summary, up to four key points and other names it goes by.
use: to define a term or sum up one policy, plan or document in a few lines
a11y: An article with one heading; the key points are a list, and the check marks are hidden from screen readers.

use_when: the person asks what something means, or wants one plan, policy or document summed up
avoid_when: an answer that has to cite where each statement comes from: use answer-sources
the details of a booking or product as label and value: use key-facts
two or more things compared: use comparison

parts.name: kind
parts.what: one line on what kind of thing it is: a noun, a policy, a plan

parts.name: title
parts.what: the term or the thing summed up

parts.name: summary
parts.what: the definition or summary in two or three sentences

parts.name: also_called
parts.what: other names for the same thing

empty.how: with no key points the block and its heading are hidden; without other names that line goes

loading.how: the renderer shows muted blocks for the title, summary and points

error.how: if there is nothing to summarise, say so in plain text instead of this part

disabled.how: the part has no controls, so there is no disabled state

overflow.how: at most four points; on a phone the padding and the title step down

long_text.how: every line wraps, and long words break
